classification.difficultyReason: Model end-of-year deposits as a geometric series and interpret five more years as fifteen years in total.

content.prompt: Lucia saves up $\$2000$ each year and at the end of the year she invests it at 6% p.a. She does this for 10 years. Give monetary answers to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
End of 1st year: $2000$

End of 2nd year: $2000(1.06)+2000$

End of 10th year: $2000(1.06)^9+2000(1.06)^8+\cdots+2000$

This is a geometric series with $a=2000$, common ratio $R=1.06$ and $n=10$.

$$\begin{align*}FV&=\frac{a(R^n-1)}{R-1}\\FV&=\frac{2000(1.06^{10}-1)}{1.06-1}\\FV&\approx\$26\,361.59\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Lucia continues investing $\$2000$ a year for 5 more years. What is the future value of her investment?

answer.worked:
Lucia invests for 15 years in total.

End of 15th year: $2000(1.06)^{14}+2000(1.06)^{13}+\cdots+2000$

This is a geometric series with $a=2000$, common ratio $R=1.06$ and $n=15$.

$$\begin{align*}FV&=\frac{a(R^n-1)}{R-1}\\FV&=\frac{2000(1.06^{15}-1)}{1.06-1}\\FV&\approx\$46\,551.94\end{align*}$$
